title: NOT AS DESCRIBED. Beware!!!!!
text:
NOT AS DESCRIBED. Beware!!!!!. The description is very mis leading. I thought this was wooden planks with the image painted on it. This is so tacky!
I'm to try to return or I guess I will use as a tablecloth. But the description needs to be changed.
